known_hardening_items_not_fixed_in_this_.description: Losing side of a concurrent stock reservation race gets a raw QueryDeadlockError (500-class) on first attempt instead of a friendly 'N units remain, retry?' message. A retry succeeds correctly with the true remaining quantity. Data-safety guarantee (never over-reserve) holds regardless.
known_hardening_items_not_fixed_in_this_.recommendation: Wrap create_stock_reservation_entries() call site with a bounded retry-on-deadlock loop (catch pymysql error 1213, retry once with short backoff).
known_hardening_items_not_fixed_in_this_.why_not_fixed_now: Out of scope for a verification mission to silently modify core reservation call-site behavior; flagged for a deliberate future hardening pass.
